scripts.build: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend build
scripts.start:frontend:phone: UNTUN_ACCEPT_CLOUDFLARE_NOTICE=1 CLOUDFLARED_VERSION=latest NUXT_PHONE_PREVIEW=1 corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend exec nuxi dev --host 127.0.0.1 --tunnel --qr --port 3001
scripts.generate:static:public: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend static:generate:public
scripts.generate:static:qa: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend static:generate:qa
scripts.static:generate: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend static:generate
scripts.static:generate:content: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend static:generate:content
scripts.static:generate:dev: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm --dir apps/frontend static:generate:dev
scripts.check: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck
scripts.docker:up: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:all: corepack pnpm styles:wp-editor && docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml -f docker/compose.cms-dev.yaml up --build -d
scripts.docker:down:all: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml -f docker/compose.cms-dev.yaml down
scripts.cms:qa:seed-block-test-content: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml -f docker/compose.cms-dev.yaml exec -T cms_dev wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/project-bootstrap/dev-tools/seed-block-test-content.php --allow-root
scripts.cms:qa:seed-writing-load-more-content: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.dev.yaml -f docker/compose.cms-dev.yaml exec -T cms_dev wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/project-bootstrap/dev-tools/seed-writing-load-more-test-content.php --allow-root
